contract_answer.question: Does replacing the adaptive gate MLP with a constant g=0.12 worsen the GateRepair parent enough across the three paper splits to credit the adaptive gate?
contract_answer.conclusion: Independent recomputation from the 600 selected-checkpoint predictions (epoch 8) gives split-42 MAPE 0.180499, Acc@15 0.4550, RMSE 51.980 cycles, bias -25.720, prediction/target std 31.11/63.92, versus NA-E010 MAPE 0.116952, Acc@15 0.7000, RMSE 41.261, bias -21.718, std 42.61/63.92 (delta MAPE +0.063547). Prefix bands (ablation vs parent): 01-10 0.2331 vs 0.1909; 11-25 0.2004 vs 0.1521; 26-50 0.1843 vs 0.1273; 51-75 0.1607 vs 0.0914; 76-100 0.1635 vs 0.0815. Per-cell MAPE: 1-6-59 0.0457 vs 0.0354; 1-8-57 0.3050 vs 0.2464; 5-3-37 0.2777 vs 0.1371; 5-5-35 0.0969 vs 0.0245; 5-8-32 0.2312 vs 0.1080; 6-6-26 0.1266 vs 0.1503. Family 3-split MAPE 0.146409 +/- 0.038529 (sample std) versus parent 0.108654 +/- 0.008549; mean delta +0.037755, meeting the +0.008 credit threshold, so the component is credited.

main_symptom: Split 42: ablation MAPE 0.1805 vs parent 0.1170 (+0.0635); family mean +0.0378 worse than parent with sample std 0.0385. Diagnostics are finite, padding-invariant, with overall_gradient_health=WARNING from branch imbalance (ext_dc/tcn_norm ratio 4.77e+04).

causes.interpretation: A prefix- and state-dependent blend is needed: a constant g cannot rise with prefix length the way the parent gate does, so late-prefix errors grow on every split. On this split removal worsens MAPE by +0.0635.
missing_evidence: Repeated-seed variance within each locked split

causes.interpretation: Six validation cells per split and one seed; magnitude of the effect may vary with initialization, although all three splits move in the same direction.
missing_evidence: Matched reruns with different initialization seeds on the same locked splits
